scope: feature evidence only; no full-family certification

validation.ctest: 94/95 passed; distribution stale root-owned dist only
validation.browser: existing test source inspected; no browser run claimed
validation.sdl3_services: passed in configured adapter test environment

features.name: unchecked/checked/mixed state
features.limits: CUI_CHECK_* model and mixed semantic value; mixed mark is a static dash, not reference spring animation.

features.name: controlled value and activation
features.limits: Caller-owned value pointer is supported; return bool reports change. This is not the reference callback builder API.

features.name: disabled/keyboard/semantic state
features.limits: Disabled and required/invalid snapshots, Enter and Space are covered. OS accessibility bridge is not implied.

features.name: group exclusivity and roving focus
features.limits: Shared integer gives exclusivity after scheduled redraw; no public RadioGroup wrapper/roving arrow navigation/set-position contract. Do not promote this combined feature.

features.name: controlled selection
features.limits: Shared caller integer changes on Enter/Space; selected activation is a no-op; sibling snapshot converges on redraw, not same-frame reconciliation.

features.name: disabled/keyboard semantics
features.limits: Disabled selected radio styling and keyboard selection tested; group-level disabled/roving semantics remain absent.

features.name: controlled binary activation
features.limits: Both pointer value writes and on_change controlled request without model mutation are asserted.

features.name: keyboard/pointer/disabled behavior
features.limits: Label click focuses/toggles; Space toggles; Enter invokes controlled request; disabled suppresses callback and skip_tab excludes control. Physical device coverage not asserted.

features.name: semantic checked state and theme
features.limits: Four themes x four sizes x enabled/on states assert role, checked, disabled, track/thumb geometry/colors; retained spring, interruption, deadlines and reduced motion also tested.

features.name: tab and reverse cycling
features.limits: Modal scope forward/reverse wrap is asserted; nonmodal scope does not promise trap confinement.

features.name: nested scope and restore
features.limits: Inner modal capture, Escape dismissal, outer focus and trigger restoration are covered.

features.name: disabled/removed target cleanup
features.limits: Disabled restored target and removed trigger result in focus0. Does not establish OS accessibility modal relationships.

features.name: OS read/write adapter
features.limits: SDL service test performs UTF8 roundtrip and embedded-NUL rejection. Runtime here is configured test adapter, not proof of macOS/Windows/Wayland clipboard behavior.

features.name: capability failure handling
features.limits: Rejected copy preserves cut source and returns CUI_EDIT_CLIPBOARD_UNAVAILABLE; invalid pasted UTF8 rejected. Not every SDL OS failure is injected.

features.name: headless adapter tests
features.limits: Mock-host cut/paste/undo/readonly and SDL service roundtrip run. No reusable reference Clipboard copy widget/value_fn/on_copied/timed icon state API exists.

features.name: UTF-8 text and theme size
features.limits: New test directly checks UTF8 bytes, theme font and color across four themes. Underlying Core handles text layout; no Label-specific secondary/masked/highlight API.

features.name: control association
features.limits: Label accepts no ID/target and creates no semantic node. Generic Core labelled_by can be used manually; not a Label association API. Pinned reference Label is a rich display-text element rather than a form-for widget, so ledger terminology needs clarification.

features.name: disabled/error presentation
features.limits: No dedicated state/options; caller can alter theme. Not directly tested as Label behavior and not a pinned Label builder capability.

features.name: platform key labels
features.limits: Explicit mac_symbols modifier formatting, UTF8 truncation and required output length tested. Key string is caller supplied; reference alias/case/arrow/Enter normalization is absent.

features.name: grouped shortcut rendering
features.limits: One supplied chord in one badge. Multiple badges can be composed manually, no shortcut group/action binding lookup API. Pinned Kbd itself renders one formatted stroke; grouped ledger requirement is broader than this primitive.

features.name: accessible description
features.limits: Name equals supplied chord under LABEL role, directly asserted. details.description is not populated and native OS accessibility bridge is absent; interpret ledger phrase as accessible name only.
features.promotion_condition: Rename feature to accessible name; semantic details.description is absent.

features.name: placeholder sizes/layout
features.limits: Fixed width/height, radius and secondary alpha checked. Arbitrary reference Styled refinement/full-width defaults are not mirrored.

features.name: loading semantics
features.limits: Skeleton submits no semantics. Loading owner/busy relationship is application responsibility. Pinned Skeleton also draws a div without explicit loading semantics; retain as product gap, not invented reference equivalence.

features.name: theme/motion states
features.limits: Four-theme border-based color, secondary opacity, phase .5 pulse and reduced static alpha/invalidation covered. Cosine pulse differs from reference skeleton token + 2s bounce ease_in_out; exact source style/motion parity remains incomplete.

features.name: animation scheduling
features.limits: Requests redraw while active, caller owns phase; no duration/easing/deadline scheduler API. Reference rotates Loader icon over .8s; CUI eight-dot alpha head is materially different.

features.name: sizes and theme
features.limits: 32px bounds and eight-dot geometry over four themes directly asserted. Public size float and primary color do not cover reference custom icon/color/easing options.

features.name: reduced motion and status semantics
features.limits: Reduced mode submits Loading STATUS and no redraw; animated mode invalidates. Name/status snapshot is not an OS screen-reader test.
